title: Simple Gifts
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 4 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
Row 5 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 6 "pass through" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 7 "next neighbors swing - end facing down in a short line of four" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A swing that ends facing down the hall is drawn ending facing across; the down the hall that follows turns the lines.
